rationale: The continuation thesis is fully intact one minute in — price sits below session VWAP ($13.23) and the 5m 9-EMA ($13.14) in the bottom 10% of the day's range, the tape stays risk-off (SPY -0.72%, VIXY +2.54%), and no new headlines or reversal signature (no VWAP reclaim, no capitulation) has emerged to invalidate the short.
